about.title: About {{brand}}
about.description: {{brand}} is a marketplace built around how people already do business. Browse listings by category, search for exactly what you need, and message sellers directly to ask questions, negotiate, and arrange a meetup. List an item in minutes with photos, a price, and a description, then track offers and messages from interested buyers. Follow sellers you trust, save your favorite listings, and leave reviews to help others shop with confidence.
